description.p: blunderDB is a desktop application (GUI and CLI) for importing, storing, searching and studying backgammon positions from eXtreme Gammon, GnuBG, BGBlitz and Jellyfish.

ul.li: Import matches from eXtreme Gammon (.xg/.xgp), GnuBG (.sgf), BGBlitz (.bgf) and Jellyfish (.mat)
Search positions by checker structure, pip count, equity, error threshold, dice and contact
Spaced-repetition (FSRS/Anki-style) flash cards for position review
Embedded evaluator (gammonNet) for offline cube and checker-play analysis, plus a bearoff/race panel with an embedded GNUbg two-sided database
Collections, tournaments and Match Equity Tables

screenshot.caption: Match review: candidate checker plays ranked by equity
Eval panel: the embedded gammonNet evaluator, offline
Stats dashboard: PR, checker PR and cube PR at a glance
Spaced-repetition study with the Anki panel
Search panel: filter positions by checker structure, cube and score

ul.li: CLI: new blunderdb collection and blunderdb anki command families
Server mode ships as a Docker image (ghcr.io/kevung/blunderdb-serve) and watermarks its exports
Every release now ships winget and Homebrew manifests plus a Flatpak bundle
Paginated library view, shared modal dialog foundation, and a smaller binary

description.p: Fixes a broken release build caused by a stray go.mod directive; refactors the search panel's numeric filters onto a shared declarative table.

ul.li: Embedded evaluator: gammonNet, a neural network ported to Go, analyses any position offline with 0- to 2-ply search and cube decisions
The Bearoff panel becomes the Eval panel, with normalised match equities and the "too good to double" verdict
Progressive evaluation (instant 0-ply, refined 2-ply at rest) and a bounded, resumable post-import analysis batch

description.p: Fixes the Stats panel freezing the interface when no database is open; dependency updates.

ul.li: Stats panel gains a Players tab comparing every player in the database
Dice luck is now recorded and shown per roll
Cube error direction (offer vs. respond) shown in the Errors tab
New "Compact database" command (blunderdb vacuum)
The EPC panel becomes the Bearoff panel with full race analysis: win probabilities, money equities and the best cube decision
Exact bearoff verdicts up to 6 checkers per side (embedded GNUbg database), estimated regime beyond that
Downloadable extended database (up to 11 checkers per side) and full board editing
Controlled sharing of a database: an origin watermark and optional password protection (encrypted .dbx)
Redesigned, faster export window and reorganised preferences

description.p: Fixes losing the best-move data when copying a position between databases, plus a dependency security update.

ul.li: Search by comment: "contains text", "has a comment" or "no comment"
Positions flagged in eXtreme Gammon are now imported and searchable
Export a match to Jellyfish/gnubg (.mat) format from the interface and the CLI
Safe concurrent opening: a database already open for writing elsewhere now opens read-only
New "excluded dice" search filter
Search panel: unified "Matches & Tournaments" picker replacing free-text ID fields
New "individually imported" search filter
Native Linux packaging: .deb/.rpm packages

description.p: Search performance fixes: corrected analysis decompression, added missing indexes, faster large-database queries.
